location: Kantipur Colony and Nakhipot, Lalitpur Ward 14, Nepal

model.feature_policy: City, district, and basin identity excluded from predictors

pings.label: Kantipur Colony rescue risk
pings.reason: The Kantipur Colony lowlands sit beside the rapidly rising Nakkhu River, while the nearby connector road progressively floods and narrows the rescue window.
pings.recommended_action: Stage a rope or boat team near Kantipur Colony before access degrades.

pings.label: Lowlands housing damage
pings.reason: Low-lying homes near the southern access road are exposed as modeled water depth increases around Kantipur Colony.
pings.recommended_action: Issue targeted evacuation guidance for low-lying homes.

pings.label: Nakhipot bridge disruption
pings.reason: Modeled water depth rises on the west access bridge, increasing travel time before the crossing approaches its restriction threshold.
pings.recommended_action: Move response vehicles across the bridge before the modeled closure window.

pings.label: Nakkhu Riverbend severe impact
pings.reason: The riverbend combines growing local flood depth with limited outbound road redundancy, concentrating several impact pathways in one area.
pings.recommended_action: Prioritize the low-lying riverbend for early warning and rescue coverage.

pings.label: Nakkhu East rescue risk
pings.reason: The east bridge is one of the fastest-rising modeled crossings and may divide responders from exposed neighborhoods south of the river.
pings.recommended_action: Pre-position a rescue crew on the south side before the east crossing becomes restricted.

pings.label: Kantipur North housing exposure
pings.reason: This residential cluster has lower modeled road depth than the riverbank, but continued flood growth can still reduce safe household evacuation options.
pings.recommended_action: Send an early household warning and keep the northern access route clear.

pings.label: Nakhipot East housing exposure
pings.reason: Flood depth grows along the approach serving Nakhipot East, increasing the chance that residents must evacuate before road conditions worsen.
pings.recommended_action: Notify exposed households and direct them toward Nakhipot Civic Shelter.

pings.label: Central low-road disruption
pings.reason: The central low road carries the highest modeled depth in the network and becomes restricted earlier than surrounding links.
pings.recommended_action: Reroute response traffic north before the central low road becomes impassable.

pings.label: Nakkhu East bridge disruption
pings.reason: The eastern bridge approaches its travel-penalty threshold quickly, threatening a critical north-south response connection.
pings.recommended_action: Move ambulances and high-clearance vehicles across the bridge before restrictions begin.

pings.label: Kantipur Lowlands severe impact
pings.reason: The lowlands combine rising road depth, nearby housing exposure, and a shrinking rescue-access window, increasing compound impact risk.
pings.recommended_action: Prioritize door-to-door evacuation checks and maintain a dedicated rescue staging point.
